methodology.passAverage: Successful trials divided by all valid trials.
methodology.passAverageStd: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the 4 repetition pass rates, in percentage points. Each repetition uses its observed task count; missing attempts are not failures.
methodology.repetitions: Attempts are ordered by execution start within each task. A later infrastructure replacement fills its original attempt slot; a complete task rerun uses the new batch order. Missing slots require explicit, verified source metadata. Ambiguous mappings are rejected.
methodology.incompleteConfigurations: Pass average and costs use actual valid trials. Repetition pass rates use the observed task counts recorded in repetitionTaskCounts, without zero-imputation.
methodology.passAtK: Tasks with at least one success across 4 valid attempts, divided by all tasks.
methodology.costEfficiency: Successful trials per $100 of recorded model cost.
methodology.costCoverage: Cost sums and averages use only trials with a recorded or repriced cost. costObservedTrials records coverage; cost efficiency is unavailable when any valid trial lacks cost. DeepSeek Flash is repriced from recorded input/cache/output tokens at DeepSeek official peak list rates without off-peak discounts; this is an estimate, not the third-party gateway bill.
methodology.evaluationBatches: Rows retain their evaluation batch. Task names match across batches, while frozen task checksums may differ; cross-batch curves are descriptive comparisons.
